behavior: The chosen profile survives a reload, the invoice detail drops its status pill, and pnpm dev runs the signer when its key is set
acceptance: After choosing a merchant or freelancer profile, a reload (and a new tab) opens the same profile, remembered per signed-in user in this browser and ignored if that profile no longer exists; Playwright reloads on a merchant page and stays there

The dashboard invoice detail shows no status pill (the timeline carries the status); root pnpm dev also starts the signer when apps/backend/.env sets EXECUTOR_PRIVATE_KEY and says it skipped the signer otherwise; apps/backend/AGENTS.md explains that a paid invoice stays on its way until the signer settles it
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: Chosen profile keyed forwend:profile:<privy user id>, validated against the user's own profiles with personal fallback; storage reads/writes guarded; saved id read before profiles load so no wrong-profile flash; sidebar, sheet, command menu and new-profile form all route through switchProfile which saves. Invoice detail pill removed; e2e asserts no data-status in Amount and the timeline's current step, plus reload and new tab stay on merchant. dev.sh only greps for a non-empty value (checked empty, quoted-empty, commented, inline comment, set, export), never prints it, keeps trap, signer only with key. Reviewer fix: moved the backend AGENTS.md signer paragraph out of the middle of the Commands list; re-verified, all 8 checks passed.

proof.1: e2e: apps/web/e2e/privy/sign-in.spec.ts 'a merchant creates an invoice' switches to Merchant · E2E shop, opens /app/invoices, reloads and opens a new tab, and both still show the merchant switcher and merchant nav (fails on the old shell at the reload); unit: apps/web/src/features/profiles/chosen-profile.test.ts (remembered profile, fallback to personal when missing or gone)
proof.2: e2e: sign-in.spec.ts asserts the detail's Amount panel has no status pill and the timeline's current step (Detected, Confirming); docs: docs/web/DESIGN.md (no pill on invoice detail), apps/backend/AGENTS.md (on its way until the signer settles; dev starts signer when EXECUTOR_PRIVATE_KEY is set), apps/web/AGENTS.md, apps/backend/.env.example; dev.sh signer branch, grep checked against empty/quoted/commented/set values
